rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Client-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.
Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Conditions that the user controls are not suited for making security-related decisions.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.
Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.
Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.
The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.
An assignment to a local variable that is not used later on, or whose value is always overwritten, has no effect.
An authorization check exists but evaluates access incorrectly.
Legacy access-control category for failures in permissions, privileges, or authorization enforcement.
An access-control policy is missing or incorrectly enforced for a protected resource.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
rules.description: Comparing different kinds of HTTP request data may be a symptom of an insufficient security check.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.
Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.
Data provided remotely is used in this external API without sanitization, which could be a security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Including functionality from an untrusted source may allow an attacker to control the functionality and execute arbitrary code.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy allows overly broad access.
The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.
